race.comment: Keen to see BUCCLEUCH (2) step out again. He was awesome first up here over this trip, bolting away by 4.5 lengths in a very strong performance. He'd looked Group class as a 2yo before an issue and should be taking care of these again en route to better races. KAHHOF (3) was a good winner two back before finishing third last start over 1410m at Flemington, beaten 1.4 lengths, shorter in the market on that occasion. He maps perfectly for an in-form Blake Shinn, wary. LOVELYCUT (10) didn't run out a strong mile last time but had been going very well prior over this trip, albeit just finding one better. Could do so again but she'll run well. FEAR NO EVIL (14) was no match for the favourite last time but will be up on speed and giving a sight again.
